name: Pakthertius Servitor

bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Threat is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting.

abilities.name: Error
abilities.text: The Servitor is Exhausted for 1 Round, This can be negated by an ally succeeding on a DN 3 Tech (Int) Test.

options.name: Fabrication Servitor
options.text: Bonus Protective Plating: This Threat's armour counts as Invulnerable to weapons with the PLASMA, MELTA or FIRE Keywords.

options.name: Medicae Servitor
options.text: Automated Care: The Medicae Servitor uses an Action to make a Medicae (Int) Test with a dice pool of 5.

options.name: Tough Servitors
options.text: Sidebar Servitor Modifications: a Servitor's Wounds and Resilience each increase by +1 for every extra point of Toughness they have.

options.name: Strong Servitors
options.text: Sidebar Servitor Modifications: a servitor with +1 Strength deals an extra +1 damage when they make melee attacks.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (grunt, Shock -). The four variant blocks (Fabrication, Decommissioned, Medicae, Warden) have no Attributes row, so they are options. No range printed on any servitor melee weapon; stored [1].
